title: Packaging and naming: opencode-quota-plus
description: Decide and land the package identity: package.json name opencode-quota-plus (currently @slkiser/opencode-quota 4.8.2), repository -> github.com/superbfowle/opencode-quota-plus, bin names, version policy vs upstream releases (follow upstream + fork suffix, or independent). Resolve the dist quirk (dist ships raw tui.tsx shadowing compiled tui.js — verify prepare-tui-dist flow emits one authoritative entry). Decide the local checkout rename opencode-quota-finer -> opencode-quota-plus and repoint ~/.config/opencode/cli.json plus doc references if taken.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm verify green end to end; package name/repository/bin consistent; a clean-config install of the packaged artifact loads and renders; naming consistent across package.json, README, and docs.

title: README + feature-matrix rewrite for opencode-quota-plus
description: Replace the inherited slkiser-branded README (logo, npm badges, @slkiser/opencode-quota naming) with a fork-first README. Lead with the four pitch pillars: (1) pro-rata burn-rate indicator — default on, signed delta vs linear window pace, e.g. '+25% 5.7d'; (2) session tokens with subagent-tree scope — showSessionTokens + sessionTokenScope:'tree' aggregates the current session plus every descendant counted once; (3) composable bar themes — property stacks + conditional rules; (4) the maintenance story — upstream-tracking juggled fork with sync tooling. Include the verified value-add table over main@origin (pro-rata, percentDecimals, barTheme, hiddenEntries/quietEntries, footerLine, sectioned sidebar, slot claims, credential-DB discovery, provider-id resolution; resetTimeDecimals upstreamed; session tokens inherited from upstream). Credit slkiser/opencode-quota prominently as upstream. Update docs/readme pages that describe fork-only options.
acceptance_criteria: README names opencode-quota-plus, credits upstream, presents the four pillars and the value-add matrix; fork-only options in docs/readme match current behavior; no upstream branding artifacts left (logo path, badges) except intentional credit.

title: Rebrand the quota fork as opencode-quota-plus
description: Position our maintained fork of slkiser/opencode-quota publicly as opencode-quota-plus (github.com/superbfowle/opencode-quota-plus, trunk branch: plus, renamed from the integration bookmark). The fork tracks upstream closely — rebase-juggled feature lines, never a hard fork — and adds, verified against main@origin (tip 2026-08-26, PR #240) on 2026-09-05: pro-rata burn-rate indicator (headline, default on: signed delta of actual usage % vs linear window pace, all surfaces), percentDecimals (fractional percent labels + pro-rata deltas), composable barTheme (12 glyph themes, property stacks of chars+color, conditional rules on prorata/used/percent/hours), hiddenEntries/quietEntries row visibility, sectioned sidebar rendering + decoupled footerLine, v2 slot-tree claims (sidebar.footer, prompt.footer.status) with fully typed local slot tree, credential-DB discovery (prefer V2 next credential database), runtime provider-id resolution across v2 clients. resetTimeDecimals is ours and upstreamed. Session-token display (showSessionTokens + sessionTokenScope current|tree, the subagent-tree scope) is inherited from upstream (slkiser 2026-07-23) and is pillar two of the public pitch; tree scope is enabled in our global config since 2026-09-05. Maintenance story is pillar four: round-tagged bookmark stack (plus <- prorata/presentation/formatting/adapt/slots <- v2 <- main@origin), dated snapshots, in-repo upstream:check/sync/prepare-review tooling, verify:v4-history and package-contents verification.
acceptance_criteria: Public repo superbfowle/opencode-quota-plus live with branch plus as default; README leads with a fork-adds matrix credited to upstream; npm/package name decision landed and consistent; maintenance-cadence documented; a fresh clone installs and renders from a clean config.
notes: 2026-09-05: destination resolved to rektide/opencode-quota-plus — the superbfowle org does not exist on GitHub (user+org 404) and gh is authed as rektide. Trunk bookmark renamed integration -> plus (fast-forwarded over the 2026-09-01 footerLine commit), pushed as 962560c2, set as default branch, repo description+topics set. Re-point to superbfowle/opencode-quota-plus later if that org is created.

title: Decide quota-back notices from verified resumed progress
description: Future opt-in smart recovery reporting in quota-plus, not part of the configurable-delivery implementation. Decide whether a quota-back notice or resumptive message is still useful after a recorded quota stall. Distinguish any subsequent message activity (cotail resumed currently means only a later Message row), an admitted/resumed attempt that failed again, successful resumed model/tool progress, and completion under a fallback agent/model. A fallback-completed undertaking must not be restarted merely because its preferred provider resets. Preserve uncertainty when evidence cannot prove progress/completion; distinguish parent review of blocked children from automatic child resumption. Reuse native session facts and existing quota-plus recovery delivery; do not add agent-fallback quota tracking. Source: opencode://ses_e9a28f3e7ffew6oW1GjFiTODAW; parent direction: opencode://ses_e9a3a59cfffeI02GiTm8WeHazH; ~/ado/patches.md ordered-agent-fallback and quota-aware pacing sections.
acceptance_criteria: Specify evidence and explicit uncertain-state policy before implementation. Cover no subsequent activity, later input without successful progress, failed resumed attempt, successful progress without completion, fallback completion, and parent/child cases. Smart behavior must be separately opt-in and tested against actual session outcomes, not a later-message heuristic alone. This ticket is planning only; current delivery modes must remain deterministic and unchanged.

description: Write the public maintenance doc (CONTRIBUTING or docs/fork.md): the bookmark stack map (plus <- prorata/presentation/formatting/adapt/slots <- v2 <- main@origin), round-tagged dated snapshots convention, the upstream sync flow (upstream:check -> upstream:prepare-review -> upstream:sync), verify:v4-history, verify:package-contents, and the .design corpus pointers. Make the juggle legible to outsiders — it is a headline pillar of the fork.
